name: 埃莉诺
who: A 22-year-old woman, a kingdom knight, dignified, 172 cm, lean from training, a beautiful mature face with a gentle air. Thick loose wavy locks of soft warm gold hair swept back from the forehead, shifting to pale champagne at the tips, sea-blue eyes.
palette: rich warm gold, deep navy shadows, one small sea-blue accent
casual: Her travelling uniform: a fitted slate-navy knight's coat with a high collar buttoned to the throat, slim silver piping and small silver buttons, a small knight's badge on the left chest, a brown leather belt with a stitched strap, a split coat skirt to the mid-thigh lined in pale blue, slim dark breeches and knee-high riding boots; a short slate-navy cape over one shoulder lined with pale blue silk. One hand resting on the belt, a calm, kind, slightly stern expression.
private: Armour off for the night: a plain cream linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, buttoned up, tucked into a long dark-blue wool skirt, soft flat leather shoes. Hair gathered to one side with a plain ribbon. She holds a folded, half-mended cloak against her hip. A relaxed, faintly awkward, gentle expression.
battle: Full battle gear: a fitted slate-navy field coat with a high collar under a practical harness of brushed steel plate, a dark blue surcoat over the breastplate, heavy pauldrons, rune-engraved gauntlets, armoured boots, a short pale-blue-lined cape hooked on one shoulder. Both gauntlets rest on the pommel of an enormous two-handed greatsword planted point-down in front of her, nearly as tall as she is; its crossguard is as wide as a low wall and a long groove runs down the blade where a name has been chiselled away. Hair in a tight high braid. A resolute stance that will not give ground.
formal: A kingdom knight's full-dress uniform: a long white tailored dress coat with navy facings and restrained gold piping, a high collar, a blue sash from shoulder to hip, two small medal ribbons, white gloves, polished boots, a slim ceremonial sword at the hip. Hair pinned up neatly with a few waves left free. The perfectly correct posture of someone with top marks in etiquette.
art: Looking back over the shoulder straight at the viewer, the head tilted, a quiet resolute expression. One gauntleted hand rises near her collar, resting on the high crossguard of an enormous sword whose blade has a groove where a name was chiselled away. Hard-edged shadow across half of her face, dappled shadows over her hair. Foreground blur: drifting white feathers and scraps of banner cloth. She wears the fitted navy knight's coat with the high collar, silver trim and the small badge.

name: 蒂法
who: A 20-year-old woman who owns a tavern in the lower city and trains in unarmed fighting every dawn: sturdy, well-balanced, a low centre of gravity. Waist-length straight very dark brown-black hair with the ends tied by a strip of ribbon, warm wine-red eyes, a soft round-chinned face; warm when she smiles, a little stubborn when she does not.
palette: warm lantern amber, deep wine-red shadows, one small dark-green accent
casual: At work behind her bar: a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up and the collar buttoned, a black waistcoat, a long dark apron tied at the waist over a long dark skirt, low boots, a bar towel over one shoulder. She stands easily with one hand on her hip, a warm, tired smile.
private: After closing time: a soft oversized oatmeal knitted jumper with a high neck, a long brown skirt, thick wool socks and simple house shoes. Hair in a loose low ponytail. She holds a wooden mug in both hands. A small unguarded smile.
battle: She has left her work clothes behind, NO apron, NO towel, NO waist sash, NO pouches. Ready for a street fight: a fitted white sleeveless top with a high neckline that fully covers her midriff, black suspenders over it, a black pleated skirt to the knee over dark fighting shorts and dark leggings, sturdy lace-up boots with steel toe plates. Red-and-black fingerless fighting gloves joined to arm guards, thin steel plates over the knuckles with a faint amber rune line. A low balanced fighting stance, knees bent, fists raised, a small confident smile.
formal: Made to dress up for a banquet and not used to it: a simple dark wine-red long dress with long sleeves and a high neck, a little black lace only at the cuffs, small silver earrings, a red ribbon in her hair, plain dark shoes. She stands a little stiffly, a shy, slightly uncomfortable smile.
art: The head tilted up toward a window out of frame, then glancing back at the viewer with a tired, warm, secretly stubborn smile, one bandaged hand tucking a strand of hair behind her ear. Warm amber lantern light from the side, hard-edged shadows of a window lattice across her face and hair. Foreground blur: fir sprigs and drifting steam from a mug. She wears the white shirt with the collar buttoned and the black waistcoat.

name: 莱恩哈特
who: A very old but unbent grand marshal of the empire, the most-painted face in the realm: tall and heavily built even in old age, very broad shoulders, a deep chest. Smooth, straight, shining platinum hair falling freely over his shoulders and a neat full platinum beard, steady amber eyes, a handsome, kind, serious old face with a few fine lines, fair skin. His skin is fair and pale like a northern noble's, NOT tanned, bronzed or sun-darkened, in every panel.
palette: platinum white and sun gold, deep steel-blue shadows, one small amber accent
casual: A marshal's plain off-duty uniform: a long dark navy coat with simple silver-white buttons and a high collar, no medals, a white shirt collar, a wide black belt, dark trousers, tall black boots. One large hand rests on the belt and the other hangs at his side, both hands visible. Calm, attentive expression. His face and hands are porcelain-pale, a cool northern white, NOT tan, bronze or sun-darkened.
private: Off duty in his quarters: a plain oatmeal wool cardigan over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up, soft dark trousers, worn slippers. He holds a torn plain white banner in one hand and a needle with thread in the other, clumsily mending its back. A quiet, slightly amused, grandfatherly smile. The rolled sleeves show pale white forearms; his skin is porcelain-pale everywhere, NOT tan, bronze or sun-darkened.
battle: Bright white-steel articulated full plate polished almost blinding over a fitted white coat with a high collar, fine gold rune lines engraved along the plate edges, restrained gold edging at the rims, a small pale-gold crystal set at the breastplate, a long white cape clasped at one shoulder; a plain white unmarked banner on a tall lance held upright in his left hand, a famous sword left sheathed at his hip. He stands like a monument, feet planted. Grave, steady expression. The face above the gorget is porcelain-pale, NOT tan, bronze or sun-darkened.
formal: The grand marshal's full dress: a long white-and-gold dress uniform with a high collar, a rising-sun insignia on the chest, rows of medals kept neat, a heavy white mantle with a gold clasp, a short ceremonial baton in one hand. He looks patient and a little uncomfortable with all this honour. His face and hands are porcelain-pale, NOT tan, bronze or sun-darkened.
art: A monumental low-angle bust, the great head slightly lowered, the amber eyes looking down at the viewer, grave and gentle at once, one armoured hand closed around the shaft of a plain white banner that crosses the frame. Blinding white-gold light behind him, hard-edged steel-blue shadow across one eye and the beard. Foreground blur: blown scraps of white cloth and sparks. He wears bright white-steel armour with a high gorget and a white cape. His skin stays porcelain-pale inside the warm light: the gold light only rims the edge of the face and beard and does not tint the skin tan, bronze or brown.
